newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen stock exchange turnover tops Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen stock exchange turnover tops Shanghai.

text.p: Turnover on the securities market in the southern China city of Shenzhen topped that of Shanghai in the first three quarters of this year, the official Securities Times said.
The newspaper said Shenzhen bourse's A and B share and fund turnover hit about 574 billion yuan in the January-September period of this year, compared with Shanghai's 483 billion yuan.
Shenzhen's turnover for the whole of 1995 amounted to only about 114 billion yuan, it said.

The newspaper attributed the surge to the Shenzhen city government's steady efforts to enliven the market and raise investor confidence in the economic prospects of Shenzhen in the run-up to the handover of nearby Hong Kong next year.
It said more than eight million investors opened securities accounts to trade Shenzhen-listed shares and funds in the first nine months of this year. It gave no comparative figure.
The paper added that about 5,000 overseas investors opened B share accounts in Shenzhen between July and September of this year.
